digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to SKILL.md and test-design.md target escape classes: parity census, config miswiring, contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and residual gaps.
Surface-parity census must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason dispositions.
Test-design.md section 6 must include config-effect contrast tests proving real behavior changes through actual read paths, not merely parsing.

Contention triggers scoped to op-level semantics must route changes by shape to existing shared suites: composed writes to two_clones, write-storms to storm suite, read-integrity to reads-under-sync-contention harness.
Behavioral gate findings require RED test first before fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly with exemption stated.
